scope: Crazyflie 2.1 reference configuration in Copter PhysicsEngine only
qTableRole: No tuning; retain all three predeclared runs. The first Q-table is a compatibility representative, not a selected winner.

protocol.successCriterion: No engine failure; 1000 steps; >=119 of final 125 steps satisfy unchanged DEFAULT_MISSION tracking limits
protocol.promotionGate: For every scenario: policy successes >= baseline, failures <= baseline, mean reward >= baseline; strictly greater mean reward in at least one scenario. Physical validation required for deployment.
protocol.selection: No tuning; retain all three predeclared runs. The first Q-table is a compatibility representative, not a selected winner.

policy.intervalNote: 150 policy episodes share 50 IC seeds and three trained policies; use per-run Wilson and crossed-bootstrap comparisons, not an IID pooled binomial interval.
